title: Schrabidium
description: &6Schrabidium&r is a dangerous material, but one which is needed for the creation of other items, such as &6Magnetized Tungsten&r and &6Ferric Schrabidate&r. It also makes for great reactor fuel. It can be created from exposing uranium ore to radiation using either a nuclear weapon or, more easily, by exploding radioactive barrels found in the abandoned nuclear powerplants in deserts.
&2When holding Schrabidium, the player will receive the blindness effect, so it is recommended that a Suit which provides protection from both Bright Lights and Radiation is used.
